names: single stage (fetch registered by the wrapper ROM, execute, write back in one cycle)

token.meaning: pc on the cycle-boundary state (= pc on the driven state, NervRrGlue.observe_agree)

valid.meaning: cycle_insn (112) = 1 and mem_rd_enable (33) = 0 on the driven state

pending_view.note: lanes 1..31 = ISA registers (RFRelN); lane 0 written by x0 writes, never read

operating.step_shape: exists y index', run1 f = (Some tt, y) /\ committing = true /\ token = pc f /\ Op (cycle s) y index'

observer.via: NervRrGlue.actual_observe (definitional; equal to NervTmplTarget.actual_observe on Lo states)
